quests.question: This person cleans your teeth so they stay strong and white.
quests.hint: This person cleans your teeth so they stay strong and white.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a dentist. Dentists check and clean teeth to keep your smile healthy.
quests.funFact: A dentist can count how many teeth you have in just a minute!
quests.wordExample: I visit the dentist every year for a check-up.

quests.question: This person takes care of animals when they are sick or hurt.
quests.hint: This person takes care of animals when they are sick or hurt.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: We took our puppy to the vet for its check-up.

quests.question: This person wears a badge and helps keep your neighborhood safe.
quests.hint: This person wears a badge and helps keep your neighborhood safe.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a police officer. Police officers keep neighborhoods safe and help people follow the rules.
quests.funFact: Some police officers ride bicycles or horses while they work!
quests.wordExample: A police officer waved to the children walking to school.

quests.question: This person asks you to open wide and looks inside your mouth.
quests.hint: This person asks you to open wide and looks inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a dentist. Dentists check and clean teeth to keep your smile healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say brushing twice a day helps keep your teeth strong.
quests.wordExample: The dentist checked my teeth and said they looked great.

quests.question: This person checks a puppy or kitten to make sure it is healthy.
quests.hint: This person checks a puppy or kitten to make sure it is healthy.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: Vets learn about many different animals, not just cats and dogs.
quests.wordExample: The vet gently checked the bird's wing.

quests.question: This person drives for many hours to bring goods to stores.
quests.hint: This person drives for many hours to bring goods to stores.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a truck driver. Truck drivers drive big trucks to deliver goods to stores and homes.
quests.funFact: A truck driver might carry food, furniture, or even toys!
quests.wordExample: The truck driver delivered boxes to the store.

quests.question: This person fixes cars when something is broken.
quests.hint: This person fixes cars when something is broken.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a mechanic. Mechanics fix cars and other machines that stop working.
quests.funFact: A mechanic can often tell what's wrong with a car just by listening to it.
quests.wordExample: The mechanic fixed the flat tire on our car.

quests.question: This person helps pets feel better again.
quests.hint: This person helps pets feel better again.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: We took our puppy to the vet for its check-up.

quests.question: This person wears a tall white hat while cooking.
quests.hint: This person wears a tall white hat while cooking.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a chef. Chefs cook tasty meals in restaurants.
quests.funFact: Chefs often wear a tall white hat called a toque!
quests.wordExample: The chef cooked a delicious pizza for dinner.

quests.question: This person uses tools to repair engines and wheels.
quests.hint: This person uses tools to repair engines and wheels.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a mechanic. Mechanics fix cars and other machines that stop working.
quests.funFact: Mechanics use dozens of different tools to fix all kinds of vehicles.
quests.wordExample: The mechanic checked the engine and found the problem.

quests.question: This person performs amazing tricks that surprise everyone.
quests.hint: This person performs amazing tricks that surprise everyone.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a magician. Magicians perform amazing tricks that surprise and delight audiences.
quests.funFact: A magician practices a trick hundreds of times before performing it!
quests.wordExample: The magician made a coin disappear.

quests.question: This person listens to your heartbeat with a special tool.
quests.hint: This person listens to your heartbeat with a special tool.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a doctor. Doctors help people stay healthy and get better when they are sick.
quests.funFact: Doctors study for many years before they can treat patients on their own!
quests.wordExample: The doctor checked my ears and said I was healthy.

quests.question: This person listens to a car's engine to find out what's wrong.
quests.hint: This person listens to a car's engine to find out what's wrong.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a mechanic. Mechanics fix cars and other machines that stop working.
quests.funFact: A mechanic can often tell what's wrong with a car just by listening to it.
quests.wordExample: The mechanic fixed the flat tire on our car.

quests.question: This person might pull a surprise out of a tall hat.
quests.hint: This person might pull a surprise out of a tall hat.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a magician. Magicians perform amazing tricks that surprise and delight audiences.
quests.funFact: Some magicians never reveal how their tricks really work.
quests.wordExample: The magician amazed the crowd with a card trick.

quests.question: This person wears a special helmet and rescues people from fires.
quests.hint: This person wears a special helmet and rescues people from fires.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a firefighter. Firefighters put out fires and rescue people who are in danger.
quests.funFact: Firefighters wear special suits that protect them from extreme heat.
quests.wordExample: The firefighter drove the big red truck down the street.

quests.question: This person performs flips, jumps, and balances.
quests.hint: This person performs flips, jumps, and balances.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: A gymnast can balance on a beam thinner than a shoe!
quests.wordExample: The gymnast did a perfect cartwheel across the mat.

quests.question: This person makes things seem to disappear and reappear.
quests.hint: This person makes things seem to disappear and reappear.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a magician. Magicians perform amazing tricks that surprise and delight audiences.
quests.funFact: A magician practices a trick hundreds of times before performing it!
quests.wordExample: The magician made a coin disappear.

quests.question: This person floats inside a spaceship far above the Earth.
quests.hint: This person floats inside a spaceship far above the Earth.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an astronaut. Astronauts travel into space to explore and learn.
quests.funFact: Astronauts float inside their spaceship because there is very little gravity!
quests.wordExample: The astronaut flew to the moon inside a rocket.

quests.question: This person practices for years to move with amazing balance.
quests.hint: This person practices for years to move with amazing balance.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: Gymnasts practice the same flip hundreds of times to make it perfect.
quests.wordExample: The gymnast balanced carefully on the beam.

quests.question: This person drives a very fast car around a race track.
quests.hint: This person drives a very fast car around a race track.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: A race car driver can travel faster than almost any other kind of car!
quests.wordExample: The race car driver zoomed around the track.

quests.question: This person stops at each bus stop to pick up riders.
quests.hint: This person stops at each bus stop to pick up riders.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a bus driver. Bus drivers safely drive many passengers along the same route every day.
quests.funFact: A bus driver can carry dozens of passengers on one trip!
quests.wordExample: The bus driver waited for us to sit down before driving.

quests.question: This person can do a cartwheel or handstand with ease.
quests.hint: This person can do a cartwheel or handstand with ease.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: A gymnast can balance on a beam thinner than a shoe!
quests.wordExample: The gymnast did a perfect cartwheel across the mat.

quests.question: This person wears a helmet and races other cars to the finish line.
quests.hint: This person wears a helmet and races other cars to the finish line.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: Race car drivers train for years to react quickly at high speed.
quests.wordExample: The race car driver crossed the finish line first.

quests.question: This person practices every day to run, jump, or play their best.
quests.hint: This person practices every day to run, jump, or play their best.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an athlete. Athletes train hard and compete in sports.
quests.funFact: An athlete practices for many hours every single day!
quests.wordExample: The athlete practiced running every morning before school.

quests.question: This person mixes flour, sugar, and eggs to make sweet treats.
quests.hint: This person mixes flour, sugar, and eggs to make sweet treats.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a baker. Bakers bake fresh bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.funFact: A baker can turn simple flour and water into warm, fresh bread!
quests.wordExample: The baker decorated the birthday cake with icing.

quests.question: This person practices for years to drive safely at high speed.
quests.hint: This person practices for years to drive safely at high speed.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: A race car driver can travel faster than almost any other kind of car!
quests.wordExample: The race car driver zoomed around the track.

quests.question: This person takes care of farm animals like cows and chickens.
quests.hint: This person takes care of farm animals like cows and chickens.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a farmer. Farmers grow the crops and raise the animals that give us food.
quests.funFact: Farmers grow much of the food that we eat every day!
quests.wordExample: The farmer drives a big green tractor across the field.

quests.question: This person fills the shop with the smell of fresh bread.
quests.hint: This person fills the shop with the smell of fresh bread.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a baker. Bakers bake fresh bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.funFact: Bakers often start work before sunrise so bread is fresh for breakfast.
quests.wordExample: The baker took warm bread out of the oven.

quests.question: This person checks the map and steers the ship safely to port.
quests.hint: This person checks the map and steers the ship safely to port.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: A ship captain is responsible for everyone and everything on board!
quests.wordExample: The ship captain steered the ship safely into port.

quests.question: This person scoops and sells sweet, cold ice cream.
quests.hint: This person scoops and sells sweet, cold ice cream.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an ice cream vendor. Ice cream vendors scoop and sell delicious ice cream.
quests.funFact: Some ice cream vendors ring a bell so children know they're nearby.
quests.wordExample: The ice cream vendor smiled as she handed me a cone.
